title: Adoption of rules.
bodyText: Each agency charged with carrying out this part shall adopt rules necessary to implement or comply with this part by July 1, 1990. All rules shall be adopted under chapter 91.
bodyHtml: §205A-49  Adoption of rules.  Each agency charged with carrying out this part shall adopt rules necessary to implement or comply with this part by July 1, 1990.  All rules shall be adopted under chapter 91. [L 1986, c 258, pt of §1; am L 1989, c 356, §15]
